statement: Akamai estimates capital expenditures of approximately $5.5 billion tied to the $11.6 billion Anthropic commitment, and says the deal is the largest in company history and additive to more than $2.8 billion in prior multi-year cloud commitments.
why: Capex tied to a signed contract is committed build, not a plan that can quietly be trimmed, so it is a firm read on new capacity entering the market.

impact.mechanism: Contract-linked capex converts into orders for servers, memory, facility space and cooling on a defined schedule.

evidence.excerpt: Akamai stated it estimates capital expenditures of approximately $5.5 billion tied to the $11.6 billion commitment
additive to more than $2.8 billion in multi-year Cloud Infrastructure Services (CIS) commitments across its customer base previously announced earlier in 2026

confidence.basis: Primary evidence: capex estimate stated in Akamai's SEC-filed 8-K exhibit.
